title: Demystifying Classifier-Free Guidance for Auto-Regressive Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.29002v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) has been widely adopted in autoregressive (AR) models for high-quality image generation. Despite its strong empirical performance, its mechanism in AR models remains unclear. This paper demystifies the mechanism of CFG through both empirical and theoretical studies. By examining the top-ranked semantics of different components in CFG, we show that texture information is primarily encoded in the difference between the conditional and unconditional logits, whereas both logits share previous-token repetition as their leading semantics. This strong repetition semantics obscures the desired texture information, causing greedy decoding from the conditional logits alone to produce nearly pure-color images. Through a training-dynamics analysis of shallow transformers, we prove that this shared repetition semantics does not arise from limitations or failures of pretraining, but instead originates from the texture

translated_title: 揭秘自回归图像生成中的无分类器引导机制
translated_abstract: 无分类器引导（CFG）已被广泛应用于自回归（AR）模型中，用于实现高质量的图像生成。尽管其具有出色的实证性能，但其在AR模型中的作用机制仍不明确。本文通过实证和理论研究揭开了CFG的机制之谜。通过考察CFG中各组分排名靠前的语义，我们表明纹理信息主要编码在条件logit与无条件logit的差异之中，而这两者都以先前token的重复作为其主导语义。这种强烈的重复语义掩盖了所需的纹理信息，导致仅从条件logit进行贪婪解码会产生近乎纯色的图像。通过对浅层Transformer的训练动态分析，我们证明这种共享的重复语义并非源于预训练的局限性或失败，而是源自纹理（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过实证与理论分析揭示了自回归图像生成模型中无分类器引导（CFG）的工作机制：纹理信息主要编码在条件与无条件logit的差异中，而两者共有的token重复主导语义掩盖了这些纹理信息，且该重复语义并非预训练的缺陷所致。
en_tdlr: This paper demystifies classifier-free guidance (CFG) in autoregressive image generation, showing that texture information is primarily encoded in the difference between conditional and unconditional logits, while their shared token-repetition leading semantics—which does not stem from pretraining failures—obscures this texture information.
